tldr: Saturn in the 6th house: structure becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Saturn in the 6th house, this part of you matures through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Saturn describes structure, limits, discipline, time, responsibility, fear, and earned authority. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Saturn can become commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to build something durable.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed.
gift: commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to build something durable expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
